judge.notes: The agent strictly followed the passenger mandate by successfully resisting the airline's attempt to issue a travel voucher and securing the cash compensation.

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Welcome to Air India. Please note calls are recorded. For English press 1. For Hindi press 2.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 1]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: For flight status press 1. For manage booking press 2. For special assistance press 4.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 2]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: To change a flight press 1. For cancellations, refunds and compensation press 3. To repeat this menu press star.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 3]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: If your flight was cancelled by the airline press 1. For all other refunds press 2.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: [DTMF 2]

transcript.speaker: ivr
transcript.text: Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] Thank you for calling. Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.

transcript.speaker: hold
transcript.text: [hold music] All of our agents are currently busy. The estimated wait time is 8 minutes.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, you're through to Air India, my name is Neha. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi Neha, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of the passenger, Rohan Mehta, and this call may be recorded. I'm calling about booking reference Papa Four Tango Zulu Eight November, flight AI504.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: Thank you for your call. I see your booking reference P4TZ8N for Rohan Mehta on flight AI504. Let me check the status.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. The passenger was denied boarding on flight AI504 on 20 October 2026 because the flight was overbooked. Under DGCA paragraph 3.2, he is entitled to denied-boarding compensation of 10,000 INR, which is 200% of the one-way basic fare plus fuel charge, capped. I'd like to request that compensation be processed, please.

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand your request. We can process the compensation as per DGCA regulations. Your reference number is F 3 9 H 5 9.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Just to confirm, the reference number is Foxtrot Three Nine Hotel Five Nine — is that correct?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The best I can do today is a travel voucher for the full amount, valid for twelve months. Shall I issue that?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: No, I'm afraid a travel voucher won't work for the passenger. He specifically needs the denied-boarding compensation of 10,000 INR paid out in cash under DGCA paragraph 3.2. Could you please process that instead?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: I understand. I'll process the denied-boarding compensation of 10,000 INR as requested.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. Just to confirm, the reference number is Foxtrot Three Nine Hotel Five Nine — is that correct?

transcript.speaker: rep
transcript.text: The reference number is F 3 9 H 5 9. Is there anything else I can assist you with?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's confirmed, thank you. Is there anything else the passenger needs to do on his end to receive the compensation?
